scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Source-domain context specialists: one LGBM per (Type of Travel x Class) segment, trained ONLY on original-dataset rows of that segment, applied to competition fold-0 rows of the same segment. Zero competition labels.

protocol.specialists: one LGBM per joint segment (Type of Travel x Class, up to 6), trained on original rows in-segment; segments with < 300 original rows fall back to the global source model.
protocol.candidate: stitched specialist prediction on fold-0 (each row scored by its segment's specialist); blended with route_ref by equal logit (no label-dependent gating).
protocol.evaluation: fold-0 AUC; port_delta vs route_ref; Spearman vs route_ref.
protocol.contrast: global source model (GEN84-style, equal blend) reported for comparison; incremental value of specialists = port_delta(specialists) - port_delta(global source).
